title: Income-tax (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026: Simplifying TDS for NRI Property Transactions
content:
# Income-tax (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026: Simplifying TDS for NRI Property Transactions

Ek important update hai! Government ne Income-tax (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026 announce kiye hain, effective from October 1, 2026. These rules primarily aim to simplify TDS compliance for resident individuals and Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs) buying immovable property from non-resident sellers.

Here's a quick rundown of the key changes:

*   **No TAN Required for Buyers:** Ab resident individual ya HUF buyers ko immovable property non-resident seller se purchase karte waqt, Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN) lene ki zaroorat nahi padegi. This is a significant relief, especially for one-off transactions.
*   **PAN-Based Reporting:** TDS ab buyer apne Permanent Account Number (PAN) ke through Form No. 141 mein report aur deposit kar payega.
*   **Amendments to Rules:** Rules 215, 218, aur 219 ko modify kiya gaya hai to specifically include TDS obligations under section 393(2) of the Income-tax Act, 2025.
*   **Updated Forms:** Income-tax Forms No. 132 aur 141 mein changes kiye gaye hain.
*   **New Schedule E in Form 141:** Form No. 141 mein ek naya Schedule E add kiya gaya hai. Isme property address, type of property, buyer and seller details (including non-resident seller's overseas address, Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) number, and Foreign Tax Identification Number (FTIN)), stamp duty value, sale consideration, payment installments, capital gains classification, aur TDS deducted ki detailed information deni hogi.
*   **Effective Date:** Ye amendments October 1, 2026 se લાગુ ho gaye hain.

Ye rules, Notification No. 121/2026 [G.S.R. 830(E)] dated September 22, 2026, ke through notify kiye gaye hain.
